arm_note: Small dated public-network case study on Ethereum Sepolia and ZKsync Era Sepolia (CHAIN-PUBLIC-PROTOCOL-v1). It is not the controlled cost experiment: the controlled local arms CSI-CHAIN-LOCAL-01 (L1) and CSI-CHAIN-LOCAL-01-L2 (local EraVM) are frozen at their baseline tags and are not changed or rerun by it. It deploys the same contract sources, compiled artifacts and frozen PS-01 proofs (depth 11) and records only what the local environments cannot establish.

admin_record.experiment: dated public-network case study (Ethereum Sepolia, ZKsync Era Sepolia)

proofs.rule: PS-01 proofs j = 0 and j = 1 at depth 11 for each backend, fixed before any public run by index (the protocol's default), never by gas; no new proof is generated

sepolia.label: Ethereum Sepolia
sepolia.native_unit: Sepolia ETH (test ether, no monetary value)

era-sepolia.label: ZKsync Era Sepolia
era-sepolia.native_unit: Era Sepolia ETH (test ether, no monetary value)

session_rule: three sessions on at least two different UTC calendar days; start times are author inputs recorded in the schedule before session 1 and never moved after seeing network conditions except by a documented protocol deviation

sepolia.gas_limit_rule: the fixed gas limits of the controlled L1 study (CHAIN-PROTOCOL-v1, chainbench/lib/constants.js GAS_LIMIT); on Ethereum the paid fee depends on gasUsed, not on the limit
sepolia.priority_fee_rule: fixed constant P = max_priority_fee_per_gas_wei (author input, frozen before session 1)
sepolia.max_fee_rule: maxFeePerGas = 2 * baseFeePerGas of the latest block read at preparation + P
sepolia.base_fee_source: eth_getBlockByNumber('latest', false).baseFeePerGas, read immediately before signing

era-sepolia.rule: zks_estimateFee on the exact transaction (from, to, data, value 0, eip712Meta.gasPerPubdata 50000 and, for deployments, the factory dependency); gasLimit, maxFeePerGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas and gasPerPubdata are the returned values, unchanged; eth_gasPrice and zks_getFeeParams are recorded beside them

common.balance_rule: the transaction is sent only if the latest balance >= gasLimit * maxFeePerGas; otherwise unsent_insufficient_balance
common.no_replacement: a transaction is never replaced, re-priced, accelerated or re-sent; nonces are sequential and a nonce is never reused
common.no_retry: no operation is retried inside a session; a failed or unsent operation stays in the record in its original state

timing.clocks: UTC wall clock (Date) and monotonic clock (process.hrtime.bigint) at t_prepare, t0, t_hash, t_receipt

halting.submitted_no_receipt: halts the rest of that network block (a pending nonce blocks later transactions); the remaining operations are recorded as unsent_preflight_failure (halted_after_no_receipt)
halting.unsent: after an unsent operation the block continues only if the pending and latest nonces both equal the next local nonce; otherwise the rest of the block is recorded as unsent_preflight_failure (halted_nonce_uncertain)
halting.setup_dependency: a setup operation whose prerequisite (verifier or manager address) is missing is recorded as unsent_preflight_failure (dependency_missing)

endpoints.rule: endpoints are author inputs given through environment variables (CHAINBENCH_PUBLIC_RPC_SEPOLIA, CHAINBENCH_PUBLIC_RPC_ERA_SEPOLIA) with a provider label (CHAINBENCH_PUBLIC_RPC_LABEL_SEPOLIA, CHAINBENCH_PUBLIC_RPC_LABEL_ERA_SEPOLIA); https only; only the label, the host and the sha256 of the URL are recorded unless the URL is listed here as public

key.rule: a dedicated, externally supplied, funded key used only for this study: CHAINBENCH_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE (absolute path outside the repository, mode 0600 or 0400, one 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex key) or CHAINBENCH_PUBLIC_PRIVATE_KEY; never a mnemonic; only the signer address is recorded
